name: dsh-theme-manager
description: Theme manager for DeepSeek Harness: one settings page that lists every theme layer injected into the page (color tokens, fonts, surface fixes, third-party skins) and switches each of them on or off without restarting, plus a page background (local image or video, swappable from the UI or by any external program over a loopback HTTP API), and the merged-in UI-harmonizer segments (official UI normalization, plugin reconciliation, chat width / font size / rounded card).

scripts.test: node tests/layer-classify-test.mjs && node tests/host-api-test.mjs && node tests/background-test.mjs
